inputs.goal: add SSO login to the web app in the platform repo

research.research_brief: To implement SSO login in the web app, I need to understand the current authentication system, identify the SSO provider integration requirements (e.g., OAuth2, SAML), examine existing login flows and security measures, and determine compatibility with the platform's architecture. This involves researching authentication patterns and ensuring seamless user experience.
prior_art: Platform currently uses JWT-based session management with local authentication
Previous auth enhancements required changes to middleware and API endpoints
Security audit previously flagged authentication flow improvements as necessary
Existing documentation covers basic login flows but lacks SSO integration details
Recent platform updates included modular auth service design patterns

plan: Research current JWT-based authentication system and session management
Identify SSO provider requirements (OAuth2 vs SAML integration)
Analyze existing middleware and API endpoints for auth changes
Design SSO integration architecture compatible with platform's modular service patterns
Implement SSO login flow with fallback to existing local auth
Update authentication middleware to handle SSO tokens and JWT exchange
Test SSO integration with dummy provider and verify session management
Document new SSO authentication flow in platform documentation
Conduct security audit of SSO implementation
Prepare rollback plan for SSO integration failures
acceptance_criteria: SSO login functionality works with at least one provider (OAuth2 or SAML)
Existing local authentication continues to work without disruption
JWT session management remains secure and compatible with SSO flows
All API endpoints properly handle both SSO and local auth tokens
Platform documentation reflects SSO integration changes
Release prepared with SSO capabilities or rollback mechanism ready

sec_hits.description: JWT-based session management is vulnerable to token replay if not properly implemented with secure random nonce generation and short expiry times.
OAuth2 SSO integration may expose the system to authorization code interception attacks if not using PKCE or proper redirect URI validation.

style_findings.finding: JWT-based session management lacks secure random nonce generation for token replay protection
OAuth2 SSO integration does not implement PKCE or proper redirect URI validation
